{"subject":"Do not submit claim C020281: duplicate of C021727","body":"Hi billing lead,

Please do not submit claim C020281 (patient PT0113, service code T1005, date of service 2026-10-04, 16 units, $76.80 billed to Summit Care Partners). The same member, service and date were already submitted as C021727, and our pre-submission check predicts this claim would be denied as a duplicate (D05). The claim cannot be fixed by editing it, so it should be held and not sent.

Please confirm once you have stopped C020281 from going out. It is currently scheduled for submission on 2026-10-30, so I'd appreciate confirmation before then.

Thank you."}
